source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.observable_verbatim: clamp fixes monitor arm to desk edge

freedoms.decision: mechanism, material, dimensions, weight limit, tool-free mechanism

ambiguities.statement: It is unclear whether the clamp must be tool-free only for removal and relocation or also for tightening/adjusting.

assumptions.statement: The clamp is intended for a typical desk with a horizontal edge and the monitor arm is attached such that its weight acts vertically.
assumptions.why: The request implies a desk edge clamp and vertical load.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: if the desk edge orientation or load direction is specified differently
